observed_structure: The helper accepts one or more FP32 per-thread register values through its thread-local input.
A first simd_sum reduces each value within its SIMDgroup.
After synchronization, SIMDgroup lane zero writes one partial per value into threadgroup memory.
A second threadgroup barrier orders publication before lanes load partial slots.
A second simd_sum reduces the loaded threadgroup partials and returns the result through per-thread state.
variant_notes: The N template parameter permits multiple per-thread accumulators to share the same reduction choreography.
A separate helper initializes the partial buffer; the caller determines how the returned reduced values are consumed.
